description: TWO live lists: `categories` — single-product categories with their product counts and canonical category page URLs — and `bundleCategories` — the curated pack ranges (Festive & Diwali Packs, Welcome & Onboarding Packs, Team & Event Packs, Desk & Workspace Packs) with their pack counts and /preset-packs deep links. Either name works as the exact `category` argument to search-products. `bundles` carries the total pack count.
name: list-product-categories
